_instructions.readMeFirst: This whole website is powered by THIS file. You do not need to touch any .html, .css or .js file to manage content. Just edit the arrays below and save.
_instructions.howToAddAnAnime: Copy an existing object inside the 'anime' array whose category is 'anime'. Give it a unique 'id' (lowercase, no spaces, use dashes, e.g. 'my-new-show'). Fill in title, genres, releaseYear, studio, rating, description. Add at least one season with at least one episode.
_instructions.howToAddAMovie: Copy an existing object whose category is 'movie'. Movies do not use 'seasons' - they use a single top-level 'watchLink' and a 'duration' field instead (e.g. '1h 45m').
_instructions.howToAddAGenre: Add the new genre name as a string to the top-level 'genres' list, then add that same exact spelling to the 'genres' array of any anime/movie that belongs to it. Genre pages are generated automatically from this list - you never need to create a new genre page file.
_instructions.howToAddASeason: Inside an anime object, add a new object to its 'seasons' array with the next 'seasonNumber' and an 'episodes' array.
_instructions.howToAddAnEpisode: Inside a season, add a new object to 'episodes' with 'episodeNumber', 'title', 'thumbnail', 'duration', 'description' and 'watchLink'.
_instructions.howToEditPosters: Change the 'poster' field to the path of any image inside the /images/posters/ folder. Recommended size: 400x600px (2:3 ratio).
_instructions.howToEditBanners: There are now THREE banner-related fields. 'banner' is a legacy fallback field (kept for backward compatibility). 'heroBanner' controls the image shown ONLY in the Homepage Hero Slider. 'detailBanner' controls the image shown ONLY on that title's Anime Details page banner. Set heroBanner and detailBanner independently to use different images in each place - if either is left empty, the site falls back to 'banner'. Recommended size for all: 1600x640px (wide).
_instructions.howToEditThumbnails: Episode and screenshot thumbnails live in /images/thumbnails/. Recommended size: 480x270px (16:9).
_instructions.howToEditWatchLinks: IMPORTANT: 'watchLink' is just a generic outbound URL field (for example a Telegram post, a creator's own hosting page, or any link you are legally authorised to share). The site does NOT include or bundle any copyrighted video files - you are responsible for only ever linking to content you own or have the rights to distribute. Leave watchLink as an empty string ("") to show a 'Link coming soon' state instead of a dead link.
_instructions.howToEditSocialLinks: Edit the 'socialLinks' object below - every icon in the footer reads directly from these URLs, nothing is hardcoded in the HTML.
_instructions.ratingScale: rating is out of 10, one decimal place, e.g. 8.7
_instructions.imagesNote: All sample artwork in /images is procedurally generated placeholder art (gradients + text), not real studio posters, so the demo never ships with copyrighted artwork. Swap in your own licensed images before going live.
_instructions.howToEditGenreMeta: Each entry in 'genreMeta' controls a genre's tagline, icon and theme colors shown on genre tiles and used as a fallback theme on anime-details pages. Key must match a genre name exactly.
_instructions.howToEditAnimeTheme: Add an optional 'theme' object {name, themePrimary, themeSecondary, themeAccent} to any anime/movie to give its details page a unique color scheme. If omitted, the page falls back to its first genre's theme in genreMeta.
_instructions.howToEditNextEpisode: Add an optional 'nextEpisode' object {episodeLabel, airDateISO} to any Ongoing anime to show a live countdown on its details page. Use an ISO 8601 UTC date ending in 'Z'. Remove the field once you no longer want a countdown shown.
_instructions.howToEditNews: Edit the top-level 'news' array to control the homepage Anime News section. Each article needs id, title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), image, summary and an optional relatedAnimeId linking to a title in the catalog.
_instructions.howToEditWatchLinksDemo: Every episode/movie 'watchLink' currently points to demo-link.html (a built-in placeholder page) so the Watch buttons work out of the box. Replace these with your own licensed watch URLs whenever you're ready - see howToEditWatchLinks above for the rules on what you may link to.
_instructions.howToEditDownloadLinks: Each episode (and each movie, which behaves as a single season-1/episode-1 entry) now has a 'downloadLinks' object with three quality keys: '480p', '720p', '1080p'. Leave any quality empty ('') to show that quality as 'Coming Soon' (disabled) on the Download page. Fill in a direct file/host URL for a quality to make that button clickable. The per-episode Download button in the episode list always links to download.html?id=<animeId>&season=<n>&episode=<n>, which reads this object and displays the three quality options.
_instructions.howToEditStreamingSource: Optional. Each episode (or a movie's top-level object) now uses a 'source' + 'videoUrl' pair instead of 'backblazeUrl'. Set "source": "backblaze" with 'videoUrl' as a direct public Backblaze B2 file URL to stream that title directly on the Watch Page - no server, API key, or proxy required, since B2 file URLs are public. Set "source": "youtube" with 'videoUrl' as a YouTube video ID or full URL to embed the official YouTube player instead (Backblaze-only features like Continue Watching, Skip Intro/Outro, and Auto Next Episode are disabled for YouTube episodes). Leave 'source' and 'videoUrl' empty ('') to skip streaming for that episode; the Watch Page will automatically fall back to the existing 'watchLink' instead, exactly as it did before streaming was added.

anime.title: Solo Leveling
anime.description: Solo Leveling follows Sung Jinwoo, the world's weakest hunter, who gains the unique ability to level up without limits, transforming into humanity's strongest warrior while battling powerful monsters, uncovering ancient secrets, and protecting the world from catastrophic threats.

episodes.title: I'm Used to It
episodes.description: Ten years ago, gates that connected our world to another dimension began to appear, leading to the rise of hunters who would traverse these gates to fight the magic beasts within. Sung Jin-woo, E-Rank hunter, is the weakest of them all.

episodes.title: If I Had One More Chance
episodes.description: Jin-woo and his party appear to have cleared a low-level dungeon, when a hidden path to an unfamiliar temple is revealed. There they encounter a set of commandments and a group of monsters that cause them absolute despair.

episodes.title: It's Like a Game
episodes.description: Jin-woo remains behind in the temple dungeon to save his few surviving party members, and with a swing from the god statue's blade, his life comes to an end, or so it seems, before he wakes up in a hospital bed.

episodes.title: I've Gotta Get Stronger
episodes.description: Having entered the instance dungeon located inside the subway, Jin-woo levels up time and time again by fighting waves of magic beasts. As he gradually makes his way forward, he finds a long stairway leading deeper underground.

episodes.title: A Pretty Good Deal
episodes.description: Jin-woo joins Hwang Dong-suk's party for a C-Rank dungeon. With temporary member Yoo Jin-ho, they defeat beasts. Jin-woo worries about no healer.

episodes.title: The Real Hunt Begins
episodes.description: While the C-Rank dungeon raid by Jin-woo and the others seems to be progressing well, the moment they step into an area covered in mana stones with a sleeping dungeon boss, things take a wrong turn.

episodes.title: Let's See How Far I Can Go
episodes.description: As Jin-woo continues his training, he completes a daily quest one day by doing more than the quest requires, and a key that leads to a certain item appears in front of him.

episodes.title: This Is Frustrating
episodes.description: Jin-woo answers a Hunter's Association request to take part in the raid of a D-Rank dungeon, where he encounters a few familiar faces.

episodes.title: You've Been Hiding Your Skills
episodes.description: At the D-Rank raid, Jin-woo is reunited with four of the Cartenon Temple survivors. Together, they explore the dungeon with Kang Tae-shik and his men. After splitting up, they hear a scream, and then.

episodes.title: What Is This, a Picnic?
episodes.description: Jin-woo survives tragedy once again, but Woo Jin-chul warns him that Hwang Dong-soo, an S-Rank hunter, may be after his life. Determined to grow stronger, he and Jin-ho raid a succession of C-Rank dungeons, but they attract attention.

episodes.title: A Knight Who Defends an Empty Throne
episodes.description: A surprise job-change quest appears for Jin-woo. Seeking strength, he accepts and enters, confronting endless foes. The final challenge, a knight, stirs memories of the Cartenon Temple.

episodes.title: Arise
episodes.description: Drained from endless battle, Jin-woo sees a phantom of his past self. To overcome his own past as the Weakest Hunter of All Mankind, he struggles to find a way to clear the job-change quest.

episodes.title: You Aren't E-Rank, Are You?
episodes.description: At Jinah's school meeting, Jinwoo is asked to speak with her classmate Han Song-yi, who has started working as a hunter. To show her the dangerous reality of the profession, he takes her to observe a White Tiger.

episodes.title: I Suppose You Aren't Aware
episodes.description: Trapped within a red gate, Jinwoo encounters a savage pack of ice elves who not only threaten his life but also taunt him about his humanity, forcing him into a deadly confrontation.

episodes.title: Still a Long Way to Go
episodes.description: Jinwoo, now more powerful after conquering 19 dungeons, returns to the treacherous S-Rank Demon's Castle. His mission to obtain rare ingredients for the Elixir of Life, a crucial step in his quest to save his ailing mother.

episodes.title: I Need to Stop Faking
episodes.description: Jinwoo realizes that he'll need to become even stronger in order to clear the Demon's Castle and decides to have his hunter rank reassessed.

episodes.title: This Is What We're Trained to Do
episodes.description: Before attempting to finish the Demon's Castle, Jinwoo decides to earn some money to help prepare.

episodes.title: Don't Look Down on My Guys
episodes.description: Jinwoo decides to help hunters guild strike team who is confronting the high orc Shaman Kargalgan which results in the epic fight.

episodes.title: The 10th S-Rank Hunter
episodes.description: Jinwoo officially becomes an S-Rank hunter, allowing him to finalize his preparations for the Demon's Castle.

episodes.title: Looking Up Was Tiring Me Out
episodes.description: Seeking the remaining ingredient for the Elixir of Life, Jinwoo continues his conquest of the Demon's Castle.

episodes.title: It Was All Worth It
episodes.description: Jinwoo tries to cure his mother with the Elixir of Life while preparations for the 4th Jeju Island Raid begin.

episodes.title: We Need a Hero
episodes.description: S-Rank hunters spar in preparation for the Jeju Island raid, honing their skills for the imminent battle against powerful magic beasts.

episodes.title: It's Going to Get Even More Intense
episodes.description: As the S-rank hunters continue fighting, they're confronted by a new magic beast resembling a humanoid ant.

episodes.title: Are You the King of Humans
episodes.description: Jinwoo arrives at Jeju Island to save the S-Rank hunters, but to do that he'll have to face the Ant King.

episodes.title: On to the Next Target
episodes.description: After no shortage of hardship, the 4th Jeju Island raid comes to a close. But for Jinwoo, the hunt never ends.

anime.title: Jujutsu Kaisen
anime.description: A high schooler swallows a cursed talisman to save his friends and is pulled into a hidden world where exorcists battle monstrous curses born from human emotion.

episodes.title: Ryomen Sukuna
episodes.description: As Itadori Yuuji cares for his grandpa, Jujutsu sorcerer Fushiguro Megumi worries that he's carrying a cursed object of rare power. The Occult club messes with something far beyond their understanding

episodes.title: For Myself
episodes.description: Following the delay of his secret execution, Yuji is brought to Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School. He's interviewed by the principal, who tests his convictions to see if he's worthy of becoming a sorcerer.

episodes.title: Girl of Steel
episodes.description: A new freshman arrives to join the Itadori and Fushiguro group. She barely arrives in Tokyo, and is already put to the test on her first exorcism mission.

episodes.title: Curse Womb Must Die
episodes.description: The three Jujutsu first years are sent to rescue inmates of a detention center haunted by a Cursed Womb. With the potential to spawn a Special Grade Cursed Spirit, the young Sorcerers are faced with the choice to run or die.

episodes.title: Curse Womb Must Die -II-
episodes.description: Yuji fails to regain control of his own body, forcing Fushiguro to take drastic measures. Meanwhile, the school's veterans finally introduce themselves.

episodes.title: After Rain
episodes.description: Yuji and Sukuna have a conversation outside the material plane, while Gojo expresses his desire to bring about a revolution in the Jujutsu world - through education.

episodes.title: Assault
episodes.description: While in transit, Gojo is suddenly attacked by the special-grade cursed spirit, Jogo. After launching several attacks that never hit, Jogo comes face-to-face with Gojo's strength.

episodes.title: Boredom
episodes.description: Kugisaki and Fushiguro continue to prepare for the Exchange Event, but some visitors from Kyoto decide to jump the gun and test their colleagues in the capital.

episodes.title: Small Fry and Reverse Retribution
episodes.description: Junpei is a fragile boy, who suffers at school, and who is about to find refuge in the world of curses. Meanwhile, Yuuji investigates murders alongside a new partner: Nanami.

episodes.title: Idle Transfiguration
episodes.description: Itadori's assignment is to investigate whether or not Junpei possesses sorcerer potential or is just an ordinary person. If he shows he has potential, he is to bring him in for questioning. Kento confronts the curse that is guiding Junpei

episodes.title: Narrow-minded
episodes.description: Kento's fight with the curse that is manipulating Junpei goes into overtime. Itadori makes contact with Junpei.

episodes.title: To You, Someday
episodes.description: Yuji tries to reach what's left of Junpei's heart with both his fists and his words.

episodes.title: Tomorrow
episodes.description: Yuji and Kento continue their battle against Mahito, who develops his powers in unexpected ways.

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event: Group Battle 0
episodes.description: In the aftermath of the battle with Mahito, both sides have returned to their usual routines. Yuji finally goes back to school, but his surprise return doesn't exactly go over well with his peers.

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event: Group Battle 1
episodes.description: Itadori Yuji and the rest of Tokyo Metropolitan Curse Technical School engage into their team battle against their sister school from Kyoto. However with the entire Kyoto team against Yuji, will he be able to last with his short training?

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event: Group Battle 2
episodes.description: Aoi Todo and Itadori Yuji continue to battle it out, with the former determined to strengthen his new best friend. Meanwhile, Panda discovers Ultimate Mechamaru's secrets while showing a more powerful side of him during their battle

episodes.title: Kyoto Sister School Exchange Event: Group Battle 3
episodes.description: Miwa and Maki engage in a battle of strength while Nishimiya tackles Nobara. The battle is interrupted by Mai and the twins battle it out revealing secrets about their clan.

episodes.title: Sage
episodes.description: Megumi and Noritoshi confront their similarities and differences through battle. However, the Goodwill Event is suddenly upheaved by a sudden invasion!

episodes.title: Black Flash
episodes.description: The special grade cursed spirit Hanami has invaded the Goodwill Event! Can the students survive the onslaught and escape the curtain with their lives?

episodes.title: Nonstandard
episodes.description: Yuji and Todo continue their battle with the special grade curse. Satoru finds a way to enter the battlefield.

episodes.title: Jujutsu Koshien
episodes.description: After the events interruption, the school tournament continues with a baseball match.

episodes.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience
episodes.description: Megumi, Nobara, and Yuji are sent out to investigate the mysterious deaths connected to the Saitama Urami East Junior High. Meanwhile, Mahito and Geto continue their schemes, incarnating one of the Cursed Womb: Death Paintings.

episodes.title: The Origin of Blind Obedience - 2 -
episodes.description: The battle begins, and the group is split. Fighting a familiar foe, Megumi uses a new technique, and reflects on his past. Nobara and Yuji fight Cursed Womb: Death Paintings Kechizu and Eso.

episodes.title: Accomplices
episodes.description: The Cursed Wombs: Death Paintings, Eso and Kechizu, face off against Itadori and Kugisaki--however, the two begin to rot after they're bathed in the blood of Eso and Kechizu.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory
episodes.description: Year 2006. Sorceress Utahime and Mei Mei are investigating a Western-style mansion that has a history. Suddenly, the building begins to collapse and they are thrown into the air.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory: Part 2
episodes.description: Gojo and Geto are assigned the task of guarding and erasing a Star Plasma Vessel Riko Amanai when two groups try to get rid of her.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory: Part 3
episodes.description: Gojo, Geto and Amanai rescue Kuroi. They then set off together to the island of Okinawa. However, back in Tokyo, the group is ambushed by somebody with only one goal - to prevent the fusion of Riko Amanai and Tengen.

episodes.title: Hidden Inventory: Part 4
episodes.description: Let's go home, Riko-chan. The moment Geto extends a hand to Amanai, the worst that could possibly happen does. Geto is left dumbstruck as Toji Fushiguro makes his appearance. Toji then declares that he killed Satoru Gojo.

episodes.title: Premature Death
episodes.description: Gojo becomes the strongest and starts handling missions alone. Geto feels lost while tirelessly exorcising and absorbing cursed spirits until another sorcerer appears, spreading her ideology on Geto.

episodes.title: It's Like That
episodes.description: After finishing a mission one day, Itadori decides to go to the movies, Kugisaki decides to go shopping, and Fushiguro goes home. After parting ways Kugisaki is approached by a woman who suddenly asks if she was with Itadori.

episodes.title: Evening Festival
episodes.description: The fight between Mahito and Mechamaru continues. A few days later, on October 31, 2018, an unknown curtain is cast over Shibuya. The people trapped inside repeat only one thing: Bring Satoru Gojo.

episodes.title: The Shibuya Incident
episodes.description: Satoru Gojo enters Shibuya. The fight between the strongest sorcerer and the most evil curses begins. Meanwhile, Yuji works with Mei Mei and Ui Ui in order to get Yuji to be Gojo's backup as soon as possible.

episodes.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Open
episodes.description: The battle between Gojo and the cursed spirits continues and reaches a climax with an unexpected arrival.

episodes.title: Pandemonium
episodes.description: Gojo has been sealed in the Prison realm. It's time for the three sorcerer groups to enter Shibuya, save entrapped civilians and rescue Satoru Gojo.

episodes.title: Seance
episodes.description: Team Nanami regroups with Yuji and formulate a plan to rescue Satoru Gojo. Yuji, Megumi and Takuma encounter a sorcerer capable of contacting the dead.

episodes.title: Dull Knife
episodes.description: The curtain preventing the sorcerers from entering Shibuya Station is finally lifted and the teams can continue their rescue operation. However, with Ino heavily injured, Yuji and Megumi must split up. Nobara encounters a curse user.

episodes.title: Red Scale
episodes.description: Yuji finally arrives at Shibuya Station, but is met with unexpected opposition.

episodes.title: Fluctuations
episodes.description: As Mei Mei approaches Shibuya Station, Kenjaku meets her midway and calls out a special grade disease curse that she must defeat. Meanwhile, Naobito, Nanami and Maki encounter a curse.

episodes.title: Fluctuations - Part 2
episodes.description: Nanami, Maki, and Naobito are driven to the edge after the Special-Grade Cursed Spirit, Dagon, activates his Domain Expansion. Fushiguro gives them a glimpse of a way to escape death, then Toji intrudes upon the fight.

episodes.title: Thunderclap
episodes.description: Megumi is overwhelmed by Toji's pure power as he attacks the young sorcerer. Meanwhile, Panda and Kusakabe get entangled in the battle between Jogo and Sukuna.

episodes.title: Thunderclap - Part 2
episodes.description: In a desperate situation, Megumi forces Haruta into an unbeatable exorcism ritual against the out-of-control Mahoraga, his strongest shikigami, but Sukuna intervenes to ensure his plans with Megumi go on without any problems.

episodes.title: Right and Wrong
episodes.description: Yuji regains control of his body, only to witness the damage caused by Sukuna's merciless rampage. Meanwhile, Nanami, badly injured and delirious, confronts a group of transfigured humans and reunites with a familiar foe.

episodes.title: Right and Wrong - Part 2
episodes.description: Yuji and Mahito's fight continues. However, Yuji is unaware that Mahito has already divided into two beings, one of which is battling Nobara elsewhere. He intends to use her to permanently crush Yuji's spirit.

episodes.title: Right and Wrong - Part 3
episodes.description: Yuji's determination falters when Mahito attacks Nobara, but just as things appear bleak, Yuji's best friend arrives, reigniting his spirit. Now all three go beyond their limits as they fight to kill.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis
episodes.description: Mahito's fight against Yuji and Todo continues. Thanks to everything that happened during his battle with these sorcerers, Mahito finally discovers the true nature of his soul and takes on a new deadly form.

episodes.title: Metamorphosis - Part 2
episodes.description: The Shibuya incident is coming to an end and many groups of jujutsu sorcerers are getting ready for what may happen next. Meanwhile, Yuji's victory over Mahito is short-lived as the two are confronted by the mastermind behind everything.

episodes.title: Shibuya Incident - Gate, Close
episodes.description: The Shibuya Incident comes to a close. Yuki and Geto argue over their ideals of cursed energy. A long awaited sorcerer returns to the cursed filled Japan to execute.

episodes.title: Execution
episodes.description: While Yuji grapples with weight of his sins, Naoya Zen'in and Yuta Okkotsu set out to execute him.

episodes.title: One More Time
episodes.description: After fighting Yuta, Yuji learns his real objective. Megumi asks for Yuji's help to save his sister.

episodes.title: About the Culling Game
episodes.description: Itadori and his friends speak with Tengen about Kenjaku's objectives and their plans for the Culling Game.

episodes.title: Perfect Preparation
episodes.description: After being sent to collect cursed tools, Maki must fight her own family to avenge her sister.

episodes.title: Fever
episodes.description: Yuji and Fushiguro go to Hakari's fight club hoping to meet him and recruit him.

episodes.title: Cog
episodes.description: Fushiguro and Panda fight Kirara to try and persuade them while Yuji attempts to convince Hakari.

episodes.title: Tokyo No. 1 Colony, Part 1
episodes.description: Yuji's group enters two of the colonies and fight the Culling Game's newbie hunters.

episodes.title: Tokyo No. 1 Colony, Part 2
episodes.description: Yuji and Megumi are separated upon entering the Tokyo No. 1 colony, with Yuji guided by former student Rin Amai while Megumi follows Remi

episodes.title: Tokyo No. 1 Colony, Part 3
episodes.description: Yuji Itadori fights Hiromi Higuruma.

episodes.title: Tokyo No. 1 Colony, Part 4
episodes.description: Megumi will find himself up against some pretty problematic odds.

episodes.title: Tokyo Colony No. 1, Part 5
episodes.description: Megumi Fushiguro fights Reggie.

episodes.title: Sendai Colony
episodes.description: Okkotsu fights three powerful sorcerers in Sendai Colony.

anime.title: Attack on Titan
anime.description: Humanity hides behind massive walls to survive against man-eating Titans, until one young soldier's rage uncovers the truth about the world outside.

episodes.title: To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 1
episodes.description: In a walled city besieged by fear of Titans, impulsive Eren dreams of the world beyond the walls - until a sudden attack shatters the fragile peace and changes everything.

episodes.title: That Day: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 2
episodes.description: As Titans overrun Shiganshina, Eren, Mikasa, and Armin flee for their lives while the fall of their home thrusts them into a harsh new reality.

episodes.title: A Dim Light Amid Despair: Humanity's Comeback, Part 1
episodes.description: As Eren begins Cadet Corps training, a difficult maneuvering test threatens his dream of joining humanity's fight against the Titans.

episodes.title: The Night of the Closing Ceremony: Humanity's Comeback, Part 2
episodes.description: As the cadets graduate, choosing between safety and the front lines sparks tension while Eren reaffirms his resolve to fight the Titans.

episodes.title: First Battle: The Struggle for Trost, Part 1
episodes.description: After the Colossal Titan breaches Trost's gate, Eren and the newly graduated cadets are thrown into their first true battle as Titans overrun the district.

episodes.title: The World the Girl Saw: The Struggle for Trost, Part 2
episodes.description: As Titans overrun Trost, Mikasa battles to survive while memories of her past and the people she fights for strengthen her resolve.

episodes.title: Small Blade: The Struggle for Trost, Part 3
episodes.description: With Trost overrun and gas running low, Mikasa rallies the cadets for a desperate push to reach the supply depot.

episodes.title: I Can Hear His Heartbeat: The Struggle for Trost, Part 4
episodes.description: With supplies dwindling and Titans surrounding headquarters, Armin stakes the cadets' survival on a daring plan that could turn the tide in Trost.

episodes.title: Whereabouts of His Left Arm: The Struggle for Trost, Part 5
episodes.description: With Trost in chaos, Eren, Mikasa, and Armin face a shocking new threat as fear and suspicion from their own side prove as dangerous as the Titans outside.

episodes.title: Response: The Struggle for Trost, Part 6
episodes.description: After a shocking turn in Trost, panic and suspicion spread as Armin tries to convince an unyielding commander to trust a desperate gamble against the Titans.

episodes.title: Idol: The Struggle for Trost, Part 7
episodes.description: Commander Pixis rallies fearful troops around a desperate plan to save Trost, with Eren at the center of the mission.

episodes.title: Wound: The Struggle for Trost, Part 8
episodes.description: As the operation to reclaim Trost falters, Armin tries to reach Eren while Jean and the cadets face a relentless Titan assault.

episodes.title: Primal Desire: The Struggle for Trost, Part 9
episodes.description: As the plan to seal Trost's breach begins, Eren struggles to control his power while his comrades risk everything to clear a path for him.

episodes.title: Can't Look Into His Eyes Yet: Eve of The Counterattack, Part 1
episodes.description: A military tribunal weighs Eren's fate as fear and politics divide those who see him as humanity's greatest hope or a threat to be eliminated.

episodes.title: Special Operations Squad: Eve of the Counterattack, Part 2
episodes.description: Eren joins the Special Operations Squad at an abandoned castle, where he meets his new comrades and gets a firsthand look at the Scouts' strange Titan research.

episodes.title: What Needs to Be Done Now: Eve of the Counterattack, Part 3
episodes.description: Amid mounting suspicion, the cadets must choose which corps to join as humanity prepares for its next counterattack.

episodes.title: Female Titan: The 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls, Part 1
episodes.description: During the Scouts' 57th expedition beyond the Walls, Eren and his comrades encounter a terrifying new Titan that throws their mission - and their survival - into doubt.

episodes.title: Forest of Giant Trees: The 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls, Part 2
episodes.description: As the Scouts enter the Forest of Giant Trees, Eren must trust Levi's squad when a relentless Titan closes in and the mission takes a dangerous turn.

episodes.title: Bite: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 3
episodes.description: On the Scouts' deadly expedition beyond the walls, Eren must decide whether to trust Levi's squad or act alone as a relentless Titan closes in.

episodes.title: Erwin Smith: The 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls, Part 4
episodes.description: After trapping a dangerous foe, the Scouts seek answers as Commander Erwin's secretive tactics raise doubts and the mission's true stakes begin to surface.

episodes.title: Crushing Blow: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 5
episodes.description: As the Female Titan closes in, Eren must choose between trusting his comrades and taking matters into his own hands.

episodes.title: The Defeated: The 57th Expedition Beyond the Walls, Part 6
episodes.description: After a brutal clash beyond the walls, the Scouts' retreat turns grim as losses mount and impossible choices lay bare the true cost of their mission.

episodes.title: Smile: Raid on Stohess District, Part 1
episodes.description: In Stohess District, the Survey Corps launches a covert mission to expose a hidden enemy within the walls.

episodes.title: Mercy: Raid on Stohess District, Part 2
episodes.description: Chaos erupts in Stohess as Eren hesitates and Mikasa and Armin fight to stop a deadly threat from devastating the city.

episodes.title: Wall: Raid on Stohess District, Part 3
episodes.description: Eren battles the Female Titan in Stohess as the Survey Corps struggles to contain the destruction and fallout.

episodes.title: Beast Titan
episodes.description: With a disturbing discovery inside the wall raising new questions, the Scouts race to respond when Titans are reported within Wall Rose.

episodes.title: I'm Home
episodes.description: Sasha and Connie rush toward their home villages as Titans appear inside Wall Rose, while the Survey Corps investigates the growing crisis.

episodes.title: Southwestward
episodes.description: As the Scouts search Wall Rose for a breach, Connie's return to his village raises unsettling questions while nightfall brings new danger.

episodes.title: Soldier
episodes.description: As Titans close in on Utgard Castle, trapped recruits and their protectors fight through the night while fear, loyalty, and survival collide.

episodes.title: Historia
episodes.description: At an old castle, a cornered group of Scouts makes a desperate stand against Titans as Christa's mysterious past begins to surface.

episodes.title: Warrior
episodes.description: After the crisis at Utgard, the Scouts regroup on Wall Rose, where mounting suspicions and fragile loyalties lead to a dangerous confrontation.

episodes.title: Close Combat
episodes.description: With a new enemy revealed, Eren and the Scouts fight back using all the techniques at their disposal. However, the Armored and Colossal Titan have other plans in mind.

episodes.title: The Hunters
episodes.description: Without a way to pursue the Titans, the Scouts have no choice but to recuperate as they wait for reinforcements. But do they still have faith in Eren?

episodes.title: Opening
episodes.description: The Scouts rally and charge in pursuit, but Reiner is not quite himself while the group is trapped in the giant forest until nightfall.

episodes.title: Children
episodes.description: When the group finally flees, Ymir wonders whether she should lie or stay true to herself, even if it means ruining the lives and future of those she cares about.

episodes.title: Charge
episodes.description: While the recruits attempt to reason with Bertholdt, Commander Erwin charges forth in a desperate strategy to topple the Armored Titan.

episodes.title: Scream
episodes.description: Eren's confrontation with a smiling Titan raises questions about his powers, but any answers will come at a cost.

anime.title: Demon Slayer
anime.description: After his family is slaughtered by a demon, a boy joins an order of swordsmen hunting demons across Japan while searching for a cure for his transformed sister.

episodes.title: Cruelty
episodes.description: Tanjiro Kamado's life gets turned upside down when he finds out that his family was murdered by demons.

episodes.title: Trainer Sakonji Urokodaki
episodes.description: Tanjiro and Nezuko head for Mt. Sagiri per Giyu Tomioka's urges. On their way, Tanjiro encounters another demon.

episodes.title: Sabito and Makomo
episodes.description: Sakonji Urokodaki starts training Tanjiro for Final Selection, the test for joining the Demon Slayer Corp, an organization that has been hunting demons since ancient times.

episodes.title: Final Selection
episodes.description: To pass the Final Selection, Tanjiro uses the techniques he learned from Sakonji Urokodaki and begins his fight against a demon on Mt. Fajikasane.

episodes.title: My Own Steel
episodes.description: There are only four swordsmen left come dawn of the seventh day and they are issued Demon Slayer Corps uniforms and messengers crows.

episodes.title: Swordsman Accompanying a Demon
episodes.description: In uniform and with a sword in his hand Tanjiro continues his main quest to find the demon who murdered his family.

episodes.title: Muzan Kibutsuji
episodes.description: With Tanjiro backed into a corner by demons its Nezuko's turn to attack and prove that she no longer needs her brother's protection.

episodes.title: The Smell of Enchanting Blood
episodes.description: Two demons, Tamayo and Yushiro come to Tanjiro's rescue. Tamayo guides Tanjiro and Nezuko to her house where Tanjiro learns how to return demons to humans.

episodes.title: Temari Demon and Arrow Demon
episodes.description: Two demons, Tamayo and Yushiro come to Tanjiro's rescue. Tamayo guides Tanjiro and Nezuko to her house where Tanjiro learns how to return demons to humans.

episodes.title: Together Forever
episodes.description: With Tamayo coming to Nezuko's aid the battle reaches its climax. Tanjiro learns about the Twelve Demon Moons organization.

episodes.title: Tsuzumi Mansion
episodes.description: Tanjiro heads to his next location southeast; on the way he meats Zenitsu, one of the swordsmen of the FInal Selection.

episodes.title: The Boar Bares Its Fangs, Zenitsu Sleeps
episodes.description: Tanjiro gets separated from Zenitsu when he enters a mysterious house where he encounters another demon.

episodes.title: Something More Important Than Life
episodes.description: Inside the mysterious house, Tanjiro battles Kyogai - The Drum Demon while Zenitsu tries to bring Shoichi to safety.

episodes.title: The House with the Wisteria Family Crest
episodes.description: After defeating Kyogai, Tanjiro steps outside where he spots Inosuke who is eager to fight him. After a short tussle Tanjiro, Inosuke , Nezuko and Zenitsu head to a manor where they are taken in by an old woman.

episodes.title: Mount Natagumo
episodes.description: Tanjiro heads to his next location to a mountain northwest and he brings Inosuke and Zenitsu with him. Upon arriving on the spiderweb swarmed mountain Tanjiro and Inosuke soon run into Demon Slayers entangled in spider webs.

episodes.title: Letting Someone Else Go First
episodes.description: Tanjiro and Inosuke head farther up the mountain while battling Demon Slayers trapped by spider webs. Soon they find out that the Spider Demon family is behind it all.

episodes.title: You Must Master a Single Thing
episodes.description: Zenitsu finds himself alone in the woods where he encounters a spider with a human face. Despite being terrified he does his best and manages to defeat the spider human using a new technique.

episodes.title: A Forged Bond
episodes.description: High up on the mountain Tanjiro and Inosuke face off against Father Spider Demon, one of the Twelve Demon Moons (or at least they think so).

episodes.title: Hinokami
episodes.description: Inosuke confronts his savior. Zenitsu lies still near his death. Tanjiro faces what seems to be an unstoppable enemy, and in a moment of desperation, recalls his past.

episodes.title: Pretend Family
episodes.description: With his life flashing before his eyes Rui remembers the family he created. Meanwhile, Shinobu arrives on the mountain to stop Rui's older sister.

episodes.title: Against Corps Rules
episodes.description: In his final moments, as he perishes to ash and dust, Rui tells the story of how he came to be, his family and the family he created.

episodes.title: Master of the Mansion
episodes.description: With the battle reaching its conclusion Tanjiro and Nezuko arrive at Demon Slayer Corps headquarters where their bond is tested once again.

episodes.title: Hashira Meeting
episodes.description: Ubuyashiki, the head of the Demon Slayer Corps, finally appears before Tanjiro. While revealing that he'd like to allow Tanjiro and Nezuko to join the Corps, the Hashira are unable to accept this decision right away.

episodes.title: Rehabilitation Training
episodes.description: The injured Tanjiro, Zenitsu, and Inosuke are sent to the home of the Insect Hashira, Shinobu Kocho, for treatment. Two weeks later, Tanjiro and Inosuke start rehabilitation training.

episodes.title: Tsuguko, Kanao Tsuyuri
episodes.description: Tanjiro, who has been going through rehabilitation training at the Butterfly Mansion, works hard to keep up his Total Concentration Breathing all day long.

episodes.title: New Mission
episodes.description: As Tanjiro and the others are devoted to their rehabilitation training, the absolute master of the demons, Muzan Kibutsuji, gathers the lower ranks of the Twelve Kizuki.

anime.title: One Piece
anime.description: Rubber-bodied rookie Monkey D. Luffy drifts out of Foosha Village in a barrel, clobbers iron-mace Alvida, liberates timid deckhand Koby, and vows to claim the legendary One Piece and crown himself Pirate King.

episodes.title: I'm Luffy! The Man Who Will Become the Pirate King!
episodes.description: Rubber-bodied rookie Monkey D. Luffy drifts out of Foosha Village in a barrel, clobbers iron-mace Alvida, liberates timid deckhand Koby, and vows to claim the legendary One Piece and crown himself Pirate King.

episodes.title: The Great Swordsman Appears! Pirate Hunter, Roronoa Zoro
episodes.description: In Shells Town, Luffy frees feared bounty hunter Roronoa Zoro from corrupt Marine Captain Morgan's clutches, gaining a swordsman crewmate and drawing Navy fire.

episodes.title: Morgan vs. Luffy! Who's This Beautiful Young Girl?
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro battle axe-armed Captain Morgan and cowardly son Helmeppo to save Coby and a captive girl, toppling the tyrant and earning a Marine bounty on Luffy's head.

episodes.title: Luffy's Past! The Red-haired Shanks Appears!
episodes.description: On their first voyage together, Luffy recalls how red-haired pirate Shanks inspired his dream - and sacrificed an arm to save him - while Coby stays behind to join the Marines.

episodes.title: Fear, Mysterious Power! Pirate Clown Captain Buggy!
episodes.description: Luffy and Zoro arrive in Orange Town, reluctantly ally with thief Nami, and clash with body-splitting clown captain Buggy, whose devastating Buggy Balls threaten to level the city along with their Grand Line dreams.

episodes.title: Desperate Situation! Beast Tamer Mohji vs. Luffy!
episodes.description: To save Orange Town, Luffy faces beast-tamer Mohji and his giant lion Richie, while Nami slips off with Buggy's loot and an injured Zoro shields the townsfolk.

episodes.title: Souzetsu Kettou! Kengou Zoro vs Kyokugei no Cabaji!
episodes.description: Bleeding but unbowed, Zoro duels acrobat Cabaji atop Buggy's circus ruins; Luffy reassembles and launches the clown captain skyward, liberating Orange Town.

episodes.title: Shousha wa Dotchi? Akuma no Mi no Nouryoku Taiketsu!
episodes.description: Buggy reunites his body, fires a colossal Buggy Ball, but Luffy ricochets it back, wrecking the pirate's ship; Nami steals the Grand Line map and joins the voyage.

episodes.title: Seigi no Usotsuki? Captain Usopp
episodes.description: In Syrup Village, tall-tale spinner Usopp's fake pirate alarms hide real bravery; meeting Luffy ignites his dream to sail and defend sickly heiress Kaya.

episodes.title: Shijou Saikyou no Hen na Yatsu! Saiminjutsushi Jango
episodes.description: Usopp's hypnotist guardian Jango conspires with ex-butler Kuro to kill Kaya; his trance turns the Straw Hats into accidental strongmen until Luffy snaps free to foil the plot.

anime.title: My Hero Academia
anime.description: A superhero-admiring boy enrolls in a prestigious hero academy and learns what it really means to be a hero, after the strongest superhero grants him his own powers.

episodes.title: Izuku Midoriya: Origin
episodes.description: Izuku Midoriya desperately wants to be a hero, but he is one of the few in his generation born without a Quirk. Will meeting the number one hero, All Might, change his fate?

episodes.title: What It Takes to Be a Hero
episodes.description: Izuku accidentally learns of All Might's secret, but there's trouble in town again before Izuku has time to process it. Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.title: Roaring Muscles
episodes.description: All Might tells Izuku that he can become a hero, but does he really have what it takes to become one?

episodes.title: Start Line
episodes.description: At the entrance exam, Izuku falls behind as the other students defeat faux villains left and right. Will he be able to get enough points to pass?

episodes.title: What I Can Do for Now
episodes.description: It's Izuku's first day of high school, and he still can't control his new Quirk. Will he make it to the second day of school with his eccentric new teacher?

episodes.title: Rage, You Damn Nerd
episodes.description: Izuku somehow gets through his first day of school and falls into a regular schedule of classes and training at U.A. In their first class with All Might...

episodes.title: Deku vs. Kacchan
episodes.description: Izuku is up against Katsuki in their first class with All Might! Can he and Uraraka beat the villain team of Katsuki and Tenya before time runs out?

episodes.title: Bakugo's Start Line
episodes.description: After the combat training lesson, the students and All Might reflect on their matches as they think about their next steps.

episodes.title: Yeah, Just Do Your Best, Iida!
episodes.description: Class 1-A has to elect a class representative, and everyone wants the job! How will they choose? And what lies in wait for them at the next class?

episodes.title: Encounter with the Unknown
episodes.description: Villains have attacked USJ, and it's up to Class 1-A to stop them. What are the villains after? Will All Might be able to save the day again?

episodes.title: Game Over
episodes.description: The students of Class 1-A are up against the League of Villains. Will they survive long enough for help to arrive?

episodes.title: All Might
episodes.description: All Might has finally shown up, but will he be able to defeat Nomu and save the day?!

episodes.title: Upon Each of Their Hearts
episodes.description: As the battle at USJ winds down, Izuku and All Might think about its repercussions. Meanwhile, the villains slink home to plan their next move.

anime.title: Chainsaw Man
anime.description: A debt-ridden young man fuses with his pet devil and becomes a chainsaw-wielding devil hunter, chasing a normal life one bloody contract at a time.

episodes.title: Dog & Chainsaw
episodes.description: 16-year-old Denji has been burdened with a massive debt left behind by his deceased father. To repay the debt, he works as a Devil Hunter with Pochita, the dog-resembling Chainsaw Devil.

episodes.title: Arrival in Tokyo
episodes.description: Denji and Makima arrive at the Devil Hunters Headquarters in Tokyo.

episodes.title: Meowy's Whereabouts
episodes.description: Denji has decided that his new dream is to fondle some boobs. His partner, Power, offers to let him feel her boobs if he rescues her pet cat Meowy from a devil. With his dream in sight, Denji is all fired up and ready to go, until -

episodes.title: Rescue
episodes.description: After a fierce battle, Denji defeats the Bat Devil and rescues Power even after she had trapped him. He says it is all for the sake of touching Power's boobs. Power mocks his ridiculous motivation saying that's a pretty dumb reason, but still agrees to let him fondle her boobs. As Denji gets thrilled with the idea, he faces a sudden attack from out of nowhere.

episodes.title: Gun Devil
episodes.description: Aki Hayakawa, Denji, and Power start living together. Denji finally fulfills his dream of touching Power's boobs, but is shocked when things do not turn out the way he expected. As Denji realizes that chasing his dream was more fun than achieving it, Makima approaches him and says, If you can kill the Gun Devil, I'll grant you one wish.

episodes.title: Kill Denji
episodes.description: Stuck on the Morin hotel's eighth floor, Denji and the group are forced to devise a plan to stop the Devil that's causing the time warp. They get an answer when the Devil speaks to them, asking for Denji's life in exchange for freedom.

episodes.title: The Taste of a Kiss
episodes.description: There needs to be a sacrifice, and Denji is going to be the one to make it. In a surprising turn of events, the Eternity Devil seems to know who Denji is.

episodes.title: Gunfire
episodes.description: Denji experiences his first, yet devastating, kiss. An intoxicated Denji is taken to Himeno's house, where she starts seducing him. Feeling torn between Makima, whom he admires, and Himeno, who is standing in front of him.

episodes.title: From Kyoto
episodes.description: A fierce battle unfolds between Denji and the menacing Samurai Sword. After seemingly being killed, Makima turns out to be alive. She sets out to rescue Denji with the help of Public Safety Devil Hunters from Kyoto, Kurose and Tendo.

episodes.title: Bruised & Battered
episodes.description: Samurai Sword's vicious attack resulted in many lost personnel for Public Safety Devil Extermination Division 4. Meanwhile, Makima introduces Denji and Power to a member of Public Safety to act as their mentor to strengthen Division.

episodes.title: Mission Start
episodes.description: Aki Hayakawa meets the Future Devil and asks him what he'd like to trade in exchange for his abilities. The Future Devil tells Hayakawa if he lets him reside in his right eye, he'll let him use his powers.

episodes.title: Katana vs. Chainsaw
episodes.description: Denji, Makima, and the rest are taking down the rogue Yakuza who made a deal with the Gun Devil.

anime.title: Spy x Family
anime.description: A spy, an assassin, and a telepath unknowingly marry and adopt each other to build a fake family, each hiding their true identity from the rest of the household.

episodes.title: Operation Strix
episodes.description: A spy with the new identity of Loid Forger must find and adopt a child for his next mission.

episodes.title: Secure a Wife
episodes.description: In need of a wife for the school interview, Twilight crosses with a woman who might be the right cover-up for his mission. She has secrets of her own, though.

episodes.title: Prepare for the Interview
episodes.description: To prepare for the interview, Loid, Yor and Anya set out for a day in the town, visiting various locations to prepare to sell the image of being a normal upscale family.

episodes.title: The Prestigious School's Interview
episodes.description: The Forger family goes to Eden School for the interview, where different challenges spice things up, along with the interview itself.

episodes.title: Will They Pass or Fail?
episodes.description: Anya gets excited about passing the entrance exam but wants some motivation to study, so the family and Franky go on a role play in a castle upon Anya's request.

episodes.title: The Friendship Scheme
episodes.description: Anya and Yor pick up Anya's school uniform. Later, Anya has her orientation day at Eden Academy, where Loid's Plan B to get close to Donovan via having her befriend his second son, Damien, is off on a disastrous start.

episodes.title: The Target's Second Son
episodes.description: On Anya's first day of school, Loid attempts to get her to apologize to Damien in hopes of salvaging the plan for the two to become friends. Unfortunately, Damien's conflicting feelings for Anya may get in the way of this.

episodes.title: The Counter-Secret Police Cover Operation
episodes.description: Yor's younger brother Yuri is a member of the Ostanian Secret Police, hunting spies while keeping it a secret. But when he shows up at the Forgers' residence, their secrets come face to face.

episodes.title: Show Off How In Love You Are
episodes.description: After Yuri's visit, Loid begins to suspect Yor may not be who she claims. While Loid investigates, Yor struggles with questions of her own.

episodes.title: The Great Dodgeball Plan
episodes.description: A rumor spreads among the first graders that if they do well in PE, they will be rewarded with Stella Stars. Anya is determined to get one, so she trains with Yor. Thus begins the dodgeball match between Cecile Hall and Wald Hall.

episodes.title: Stella
episodes.description: In order for parents to attend one of the social gatherings at Eden College, their children must be Imperial Scholars. Anya hates studying, so Loid comes up with a plan for her to get Stella Stars by doing community service.

episodes.title: Penguin Park
episodes.description: A trip to the local aquarium results in mayhem for the entire Forger family as Loid is assigned a mission that is, fortuitously, located in the same place.

episodes.title: Project Apple
episodes.description: The thin veneer of peace between Ostania and Westalis threatens to break when terrorists plot an assassination attempt. The Forger family is thrown into the mayhem when searching a for a dog to adopt.

episodes.title: Disarm the Time Bomb
episodes.description: Anya is saved by Yor from the terrorists she doesn't know. The intelligent dog sees future which makes the disarming of bomb very important for Anya.

episodes.title: A New Family Member
episodes.description: After being rescued by Anya and a terrorist trained dog, Loid welcomes a new member to the family, Bond, their new pet.

episodes.title: Yor's Kitchen/The Informant's Great Romance Plan
episodes.description: Believing Loid may start to see her as useless, Yor asks her coworkers to teach her to cook. Franky goes to Loid to help him ask his crush on a date.

episodes.title: Carry Out the Griffin Plan/Fullmetal Lady/Omelet Rice
episodes.description: Anya attempts to continue the Friendship Plan by helping Damian in arts and crafts, but disastrous results ensue. Sylvia meets with Loid. Yuri toughens up to survive Yor's cooking.

episodes.title: Uncle the Private Tutor/Daybreak
episodes.description: Yuri helps Anya study for her midterm exams. Afterwards, Loid breaks into Eden Academy's vaults to change her test answers but comes across an amateur spy calling himself Daybreak.

episodes.title: A Revenge Plot Against Desmond/Mama Becomes The Wind
episodes.description: George, a boy in Anya's class who believes he will be forced to leave Eden, is treated to a luxurious final day of class. Yor dashes to Eden to deliver Anya her gym clothes while Loid tails her.

episodes.title: Investigate the General Hospital/Decipher the Perplexing Code
episodes.description: Loid takes Anya to the hospital he works at for a school project. Anya spreads a hidden code to her neighbors and classmates. Franky believes a woman may finally be interested in him.

episodes.title: Nightfall/First Fit of Jealousy
episodes.description: A new spy named Nightfall joins the peacemaking team between East and West. She thinks she can play a better role as Twilight's wife and enters into a mental battle with Yor.

episodes.title: The Underground Tennis Tournament: The Campbelldon
episodes.description: Twilight and Nightfall enter an underground tennis tournament for a mission as two players and there are no rules in this match and it's a tough match.

episodes.title: The Unwavering Path
episodes.description: Nightfall and Twilight, who went to a tennis match to get a coded painting, finished their match. After this, Nightfall challenges Yor to a tennis match so that she can take the role of Twilight's wife from her

episodes.title: The Role of a Mother and Wife/Shopping with Friends
episodes.description: Yor, who thinks that she has been bested by Nightfall is upset and sad. Sensing that his mission is in jeopardy, Twilight invites Yor to a bar to talk about it. Suddenly, something happens to Twilight that hasn't happened in years.

episodes.title: First Contact
episodes.description: With his clever plan, Twilight manages to meet Desmond briefly.

anime.title: Witch Hat Atelier
anime.description: Coco, a young girl fascinated by magic, begins an extraordinary journey after meeting the mysterious witch Qifrey. She enters a hidden world of magic where she learns that anyone can become a witch with the right knowledge and determination.

episodes.title: Hajimari no mahô
episodes.description: Coco, a girl fascinated by magic, meets Qifrey and discovers the secrets of witches.

episodes.title: Sôgen no manabiya
episodes.description: Coco meets her fellow students and starts to learn the fundamentals of magic.

episodes.title: Dada sanmyaku no shiken
episodes.description: While Qifrey is away at the Great Hall, Agott tricks Coco into a life-threatening initiation test at the Dadah Range, in order to remain at the atelier.

episodes.title: Karun de no deai
episodes.description: Coco and her fellow apprentices pay a visit to the magical city of Kalhn for supplies. However, the girls soon discover they are being watched by a mysterious figure in an eyeball mask, marking the ominous return of the Brimmed Caps.

episodes.title: Doragon no meikyû
episodes.description: The four apprentice witches strive to find a solution to their calamitous situation

episodes.title: Ame no hi no akari
episodes.description: The apprentices have an outdoor picnic on a rainy day and encounter their Watchful Eye.

episodes.title: Dare ga tame no mahô
episodes.description: The apprentices are permitted to join a dangerous rescue mission.

episodes.title: Makei-dan no ginen
episodes.description: Upon the Knights Moralis' arrival, Coco and Agott must face the consequences of their actions.

episodes.title: Kuro ni shizumu akumu
episodes.description: While Coco struggles to sleep due to nightmares, Qifrey attempts to locate the Brimmed Caps.

episodes.title: Gin'iro no yakusoku
episodes.description: While Coco feels unwell, Tarta tries to help her despite his vision problems.

episodes.title: Hebi no se dôkutsu no shiken
episodes.description: As Agott prepares for her second exam, Richeh has an argument with Qifrey.

episodes.title: Romonôn no kage
episodes.description: Coco's dreams of casting magic might become a reality after she uncovers a secret and becomes an apprentice.

episodes.title: Kinjirareta mahô
episodes.description: Agott, Richeh, and Euini are trapped in Serpentback Cave, confronting a terrifying Brimmed Cap witch.

anime.title: Lookism
anime.description: In a society that favors good looks, a high school outcast leads a double life switching between his two bodies that are polar opposites in appearance.

episodes.title: Change
episodes.description: After enduring years of abuse from his peers, Park Hyeong-seok moves to a different neighborhood to start a new life. Big changes are coming for him.

episodes.title: New Life
episodes.description: Hyeong-seok attends school in his new body by day and works a part-time job as his true self by night - only to learn that nothing has really changed.

episodes.title: Friends
episodes.description: A student by the nickname Basco helps the old Hyeong-seok fight off bullies, while the new Hyeong-seok hangs out with his first-ever group of friends.

episodes.title: Mom
episodes.description: Hyeong-seok takes his mother out to a cafe as his transformed self. Basco seethes with righteous indignation when he spots the two together.

episodes.title: Kindness
episodes.description: Hyeong-seok lends a hand to other struggling peers in school, while an enigmatic classmate offers him help and gifts when he needs it most.

episodes.title: Recommendation
episodes.description: Pyeon Deok-hwa considers performing at the school festival, while others in his class relentlessly try to trample on his dream of becoming a rap artist.

episodes.title: Spacial Training
episodes.description: Under Deok-hwa's direction, Hyeong-seok unlocks his singing potential as their musical collaboration nurtures their blossoming friendship.

episodes.title: Wall
episodes.description: Competition heats up backstage on the day of the festival. Hyeong-seok and Deok-hwa leave their past and fears behind to deliver a song from the heart.

anime.title: Vinland Saga
anime.description: A young Viking raised for vengeance survives war, slavery, and loss only to question everything he believed about what makes a man strong.

episodes.title: Somewhere Not Here
episodes.description: Young Thorfinn longs for an adventure far from his home in Iceland. One day, his father saves the life of a runaway slave found buried in the snow.

episodes.title: Sword
episodes.description: As the war between England and Denmark heats up in the year 1002, Jomsvikings arrive in Thorfinn's village and pressure Thors to return to battle.

episodes.title: Troll
episodes.description: Mercenary Viking leader Askeladd accepts Floki's orders to kill Thors. Meanwhile, Thors and his army of enthusiastic young men embark on their voyage.

episodes.title: A True Warrior
episodes.description: As the ships are surrounded by Askeladd's pirates, Thors decides to take action on his own hands in order to protect the crew and his son.

episodes.title: The Troll's Son
episodes.description: Consumed by his desire for revenge, Thorfinn sneaks up to Askeladd's bed, intending to kill him in his sleep. Leif breaks the news to Helga and Ylva.

episodes.title: The Journey Begins
episodes.description: Thorfinn kills his first man. As more time goes on Thorfinn kills more men and becomes more skilled. One day when Thorfinn is in battle he gets shot with an arrow and ends up unconscious. An English woman and her daughter help him recover.

episodes.title: Normanni
episodes.description: Smelling an opportunity for treasure, Askeladd decides to join a skirmish among the Franks. He sends 16-year-old Thorfinn to negotiate on his behalf.

episodes.title: Beyond the Edge of the Sea
episodes.description: After capturing the treasure from the Franks, Askeladd's men return to the village of Gorm on the Jutland Peninsula in Denmark to pass the winter. Thorfinn challenges Askeladd to a duel as a reward for bringing him the head of the captain of the clan of Franks. Even though Thorfinn has grown in skill through his experience in battle  he is still no match for Askeladd.

episodes.title: The Battle of London Bridge
episodes.description: In October 1013, King Sweyn leads a fleet of Danish and Viking ships in an attempt to take London Bridge of England. Askeladd's army, hired by the army of Denmark, was among them. However, after the betrayal of Thorkell the Tall, a Viking known for his overpowering strength, London Bridge has become impregnable. Askeladd tells Thorfinn he'll reward him with a duel if he's able to kill Thorkell.

episodes.title: Ragnarok
episodes.description: Askeladd's army separates from the army of Denmark and attacks a village 100 km to the west. Thorfinn leaves the soldiers behind in disgust and climbs up a hill overlooking the village, where he pledges revenge for his father. However, he encounters Askeladd sitting in the darkness, who tells him about Britannia, the aging of the world, and Ragnarok, the final battle.

episodes.title: A Gamble
episodes.description: Thorkell takes Canute hostage and follows after the main army of Denmark. Ragnar objects to Thorkell's plan to take on the entire army of Denmark, boasting 16,000 soldiers, with only 500 men. Thorkell then begins to tell Ragnar the story of Valhalla, the pride of Normans, a place where only those who die in battle can go.

episodes.title: The Land on the Far Bank
episodes.description: Askeladd and his men continue their march to escape from Thorkell. However, their march comes to a halt at the Severn River. Askeladd hands a letter to an old man operating a ferry across the river and tells him to deliver the letter to the other side immediately. As soon as he hears the addressee's name, the old man sets off in his boat.

episodes.title: Child of a Hero
episodes.description: Askeladd crosses the river and escapes from Thorkell into Wales with Canute. However, Askeladd's men are ambushed by a group of soldiers hiding behind the boulders at the border of the kingdom of Brycheiniog. Askeladd attempts to negotiate with their messenger, and reveals his plan.

episodes.title: The Light of Dawn
episodes.description: In middle of the inclement weather, Askeladd's men find a village. Cornered by the blizzard, the vikings show their true nature.

episodes.title: After Yule
episodes.description: After losing Canute, Thorkell decides to halt his advance in central England. Thorkell hears that the end of the war between Denmark and England is near, and bemoans the end of the war. However, he later gets wind of an interesting piece of news.

episodes.title: History of Beasts
episodes.description: Askeladd and his men are attacked by the English army in the village where they had planned to camp during the winter. Askeladd captures their captain and interrogates him to find out how the English knew where they were, and discovers that Thorkell is fast approaching. The news of Thorkell's arrival sends waves of shock among Askeladd's followers.

episodes.title: Servant
episodes.description: Askeladd's men continued their march to escape Thorkell. However, Torgrim and his friends were hatching a plot to switch sides and join Thorkell, taking Canute with them. Torgrim finally launches his rebellion and corners Askeladd, negotiating with him to hand over Canute, then Thorkell arrives in the midst of the confusion.

episodes.title: Out of the Cradle
episodes.description: Thorfinn and Thorkell agree to have a duel over the fate of Askeladd. Thorkell looks forward to facing off against Thors's son, Thorfinn, and asks him what a true warrior really is. Meanwhile, Canute is suddenly ambushed while he attempts to escape, and has a dream about a certain individual.

episodes.title: United Front
episodes.description: Thorfinn is told to think about what he has to do to beat Thorkell. Askeladd treats Thorfinn's wounds so that he may fight again someday, and proposes a joint strategy to help the two of them survive longer.

episodes.title: Crown
episodes.description: After the fighting dies down, Canute takes in Askeladd and Thorkell as his followers, and returns to Gainsborough. Canute goes through an awakening when he realizes the meaning of love in the aftermath of Ragnar's death.

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: Canute's party arrives in York to attend the Imperial Council with goals to strike out King Sweyn.

episodes.title: Lone Wolf
episodes.description: Thorfinn begins his duel against Askeladd with Canute and Thorkell as witnesses. However, Thorfinn is unable to strike as he stands overwhelmed by the extraordinary mood that overtakes Askeladd after Bjorn's departure.

episodes.title: Miscalculation
episodes.description: After the assassination attempt on Canute's life, rumors spread through York saying that the king is trying to kill Canute. As a result, the king is unable to issue any orders that would put Canute in harm, and

episodes.title: End of the Prologue
episodes.description: As the Imperial Council proceeds, Askeladd is shocked by the news of Wales. As he gets called by the king, he makes a last stand.

episodes.title: Slave
episodes.description: Einar, a young man from northern England lives with his mother and younger sister in a quiet farming village. One day the village is destroyed in a Viking attack, and Einar's life changes dramatically.

episodes.title: Ketil's Farm
episodes.description: Entering a life of slavery, Einar and Thorfinn begin their work, while encountering the various figures who inhabit Ketil's farm.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.description: Following Fox's demonstration and Snake interfering, Einar makes ties in Thorfinn's actions and words, and confronts him on his past.

episodes.title: The Path of Blood
episodes.description: After a sudden turn of events, young Canute must rise up to claim the throne of a Kingdom much reduced and under attack.

episodes.title: I Want a Horse
episodes.description: Realizing they need a horse to remove tree trunks, Thorfinn and Einar go to the stables. When the workers deny them a horse, they decide they must find another way to get one.

episodes.title: Iron Fist Ketil
episodes.description: Thieves have been taking food secretly from Ketil's farm. Meanwhile, Ketil's eldest son Thorgil returns home.

episodes.title: An Empty Man
episodes.description: Thorfinn has nightmares almost every night, but he can never remember what he dreamed about, a fact that bothers him.

episodes.title: Oath
episodes.description: Thorfinn is caught off guard and knocked unconscious in a fight with the servants. In the midst of this, he had a dream in which he sees his father and his arch-enemy. How will they respond to the current state of Thorfinn?

episodes.title: Cursed Head
episodes.description: Finally, after three long years, Einar and Thorfinn chop down the final tree in the forest. At the same time, Canute, who became the conqueror of England, is visiting Jelling, the royal capital of Denmark.

episodes.title: The King and the Sword
episodes.description: With Canute's newfound additional throne and the land of Denmark, he aims to fund his armies with drastic means. Ketil meets with Lief Ericson who finds out he has a slave named Thorfinn. Ketil pays tribute to the new king Canute.

episodes.title: For the Love That Was Lost
episodes.description: Olmar recieves some upsetting news, causing him to reach his breaking point. Meawhile, tensions arise as Canute sets his sights on Ketil's farm.

episodes.title: Dark Clouds
episodes.description: A slave kills his master and all his sons, as a result, a bounty amounting to three horses is placed on his head. The old master collapses tending the field and must be taken care of due to his poor health.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.description: Gardar, the runaway slave who killed his master has come to Ketil's farmstead to free Arnheid, his wife. Snake aims to subdue Gardar while Einar wishes to aid Gardar by violent means, Thorfinn, however, pursues a diplomatic solution.

episodes.title: Storm
episodes.description: Arnheid goes to the fortress where Gardar is imprisoned and asks to see her husband to treat his wounds.

episodes.title: Cause
episodes.description: Having realized Gardar is escaped, Einar and Thorfinn make their way to the old master's home to find Arnheid. The two find her and both decide to help her and her husband escape, with the three colluding in a plan to help save Gardar.

episodes.title: Way Home
episodes.description: Thorfinn, after being left with no other choice, must break a sworn oath to defend Gardar from Snake.

episodes.title: The First Measure
episodes.description: As Canute and his men are approaching the farm, Ketil returns home and learns about the events that occurred while he was gone.

episodes.title: War at Ketil's Farm
episodes.description: Ketil gathers men to fight and defend his farm from the King's forces. Meanwhile, Thorfinn and his friends try to escape with Arnheid before the battle ends.

episodes.title: Pain
episodes.description: As Thorfinn and Einar head for their escape, Arnheid regains consciousness and asks where they are going and if there are slaves and wars there, too.

episodes.title: Courage
episodes.description: The battle has left heartbreaking casualties in its wake. Though Thorgil and Ketil's wife want to continue the fight, Canute demands their surrender.

episodes.title: Hangyaku no Teio
episodes.description: Thorfinn is determined to face the brutal challenge of having to endure one hundred punches in order to speak with Canute. His father's words resonate with him as he undergoes this brutal but necessary task.

episodes.title: Two Paths
episodes.description: Thorfinn and Canute begin to engage in peace discussions for Ketil's farmland. After everything is settled, Thorfinn and Einar vow to travel to the West and create Vinland together.

episodes.title: Hometown
episodes.description: After negotiating peace, upon his return to Iceland, Thorfinn reunites with his long-lost family after a 16-year separation, and the encounter sparks within him a bigger inspiration to establish a nation in the bountiful lands of Vinland.

anime.title: Mushoku Tensei
anime.description: A failed, friendless man dies in disgrace and wakes up as an infant in a magical world, determined to live this second chance without wasting a single day.

episodes.title: Jobless Reincarnation
episodes.description: An unemployed middle-aged man involved in a fatal traffic accident awakens as an infant in a new world.

episodes.title: Teacher
episodes.description: Rudy begins training with his new magic tutor and learning swordsmanship from his father. He makes rapid progress, but traumatic memories from his past life leave him too afraid to go outside. Is his second chance already doomed to failure?

episodes.title: A Friend
episodes.description: Rudy begins to explore the village and rescues a green-haired child from a group of bullies. The two grow close practicing magic, but is there more to Rudy's new friend than he thinks?

episodes.title: Emergency Family Meeting
episodes.description: The Greyrat family is overjoyed when Zenith announces that she's pregnant with a second child, but the mood takes a dour turn when Lilia reveals that she is also pregnant and Paul is the father. Will this be the end of Rudy's happy family?

episodes.title: A Young Lady and Violence
episodes.description: Rudy arrives in the city of Roa, where he's supposed to spend the next five years tutoring the daughter of the local lord. His student, however, is more than he bargained for, and he'll have to fight to start his first ever job, let alone keep it.

episodes.title: A Day Off in Roa
episodes.description: Rudy is officially Eris's tutor, but she doesn't want to learn anything but magic. As Rudy struggles to get her interested in other subjects, he realizes that non-stop lessons are causing her stress and proposes a day off in the city.

episodes.title: What Lies Beyond Effort
episodes.description: Eris's 10th birthday is fast approaching, and her grandfather has invited nobles from across the kingdom to a dance party to celebrate. There's just one problem; Eris can't dance, and she's quickly losing patience with her lessons.

episodes.title: Turning Point 1
episodes.description: Rudy reaches his 10th birthday, and Eris and her family plan a surprise party for him. Meanwhile, the strange orb hovering over the city remains a mystery as powerful entities across the world begin to take note of it.

episodes.title: A Chance Encounter
episodes.description: Rudy and Eris find themselves stranded in the wilds of the Demon Continent. Their only chance to survive seems to lie in Ruijerd, a warrior of the infamous Superd Tribe of demons, but can he be trusted?

episodes.title: The Value of a Life and the First Job
episodes.description: After Ruijerd, Rudeus, and Eris arrive in Rikarisu, Rudeus hatches a plan to make money economically. The group experiences growing pains.

episodes.title: Children and Warriors
episodes.description: With their new money-making scheme in place, Dead End head out to track down a mysterious monster. Unfortunately, the job doesn't go as smoothly as they hope, and Rudy's plans may turn out to be a lot less safe than he thought.

episodes.title: The Woman with the Demon Eyes
episodes.description: Rudies meets a girl with a mysterious eye.

episodes.title: Missed Connections
episodes.description: Roxy, Elinalise, and Talhand discuss Dead End and future plans. Rudeus and Eris embark on a voyage to the Millis Continent.

episodes.title: No Such Thing as a Free Lunch
episodes.description: Rudeus is imprisoned in a beast people village for a crime in which he is innocent. Rudeus awaits Ruijerd and Eris to rescue him, however, days pass with no sign of them. The village is attacked, presenting an opportunity for Rudeus.

episodes.title: Slow Life in the Doldia Village
episodes.description: Rudeus and Eris find out more about Ghislaine and her relationship to the beast people's village. Eris begins to train Tona swordsmanship with the two eventually getting into a fight because of Eris' imminent departure.

episodes.title: Family Squabble
episodes.description: Rudeus and his team arrive in Millishion. In the city, he comes across a kid being kidnapped. He follows them and gets into a fight with the kidnappers, but these people are actually involved with someone whom Rudeus knows very well

episodes.title: Reunion
episodes.description: After having a family squabble with Rudy, Paul kept brooding and drinking. Will Paul's depression and anxieties continue? Or will he have a change of heart and talk to Rudy?

episodes.title: Separate Journeys
episodes.description: The Dead End party departs for Central Continent. Roxy arrives at Rikarisu and has a chat with her old party member. She visits the Migurd village and meets her parents who tell them how they have been hearing about her from the travelers.

episodes.title: Route Selection
episodes.description: Hitogami appears in Rudeus's dream again to give info about the whereabouts of Lilia and Aisha. Dead End party travel to Shirone Kingdom where Rudeus writes to Roxy and meets Aisha. Rudeus gets summoned to the royal palace to meet Roxy.

episodes.title: The Birth of My Little Sister, The Maid
episodes.description: Rudeus is in desperate straits, imprisoned in a magic-proof dungeon by a despotic prince. But just when all seems hopeless, an unexpected visitor appears with a strange request. Will Rudeus be able to talk his way out of this one?

episodes.title: Turning Point 2
episodes.description: Almost at their destination, the Dead End party encounters a mysterious man in the mountains, and things take a turn for the worst.

episodes.title: Dreams and Reality
episodes.description: Dead End arrive in Fittoa and behold the aftermath of the Metastasis Event. Rudeus and Eris come to an understanding.

episodes.title: Wake Up and Take a Step
episodes.description: Rudeus falls into a state of depression, and begins having flashbacks to his old life where severe bullying at school traumatized him into become a social recluse.

anime.title: Your Name
anime.description: Two teenagers in different cities begin mysteriously swapping bodies in their dreams, and slowly realize their connection might be the only thing that can save a town from disaster.

anime.title: Spirited Away
anime.description: A sullen ten-year-old wanders into a bathhouse for spirits and must work off a curse placed on her parents before she loses her own name and self forever.

anime.title: Weathering With You
anime.description: A runaway boy in rain-soaked Tokyo meets a girl who can part the clouds with a wish, and learns that her gift comes with a cost neither of them expected.

anime.title: Suzume
anime.description: A high schooler stumbles into a hidden door that unleashes disasters across Japan, and joins a mysterious stranger on a race to shut every one of them.

anime.title: A Silent Voice
anime.description: Years after bullying a deaf classmate out of school, a withdrawn teenager sets out to make amends and confront the guilt that has isolated him ever since.

anime.title: Jujutsu Kaisen 0
anime.description: A boy haunted by the curse born from his own childhood promise enrolls at a school for exorcists, hoping to find a place where his power finally means something good.

news.summary: Ufotable shares new details on the upcoming film closing out the Infinity Castle arc, including a first look at key animation.

news.summary: The Straw Hats set sail into a brand-new arc this week, picking up immediately after the events of Egghead Island.

news.title: Jujutsu Kaisen Special Episode
news.summary: MAPPA announces a one-off special episode bridging the gap before the next major arc, airing alongside a remastered broadcast.

news.summary: Studios and publishers celebrate the series' anniversary with a retrospective exhibition and a newly illustrated key visual.
